registration_rule: same plugin_id + version + artifact_hash + contract_hash registration is idempotent; any identity field difference is a conflict and is rejected
owner_rule: a plugin_id is owned by exactly one owner in the catalog
hash_rule: declared artifact_hash and contract_hash must match the registered artifact and contract digests; mismatch is rejected
dependency_rule: version dependencies must resolve inside the catalog; missing or unsatisfied dependency is rejected; dependency cycles are rejected
snapshot_rule: catalog snapshot is an immutable read-only view and can never be a business request input
